confirm.installCert.description: The local dns-quorum-filter certificate will be added to the current user's trusted root certificates (CurrentUser\Root). This removes the browser's untrusted-certificate warning on the settings page. Windows may show its own confirmation dialog. Continue?
confirm.uninstallCert.description: The local dns-quorum-filter certificate will be removed from the trusted root certificates. The browser will again show an untrusted-certificate warning on the settings page until the certificate is installed again. Continue?
confirm.rotateCert.description: A new local dns-quorum-filter certificate with a new key will be generated. This project's old entries are removed from the trusted root certificates (CurrentUser\Root), and the new certificate is installed in their place. dnsqb-service needs to be restarted for the new certificate to take effect - until then it keeps serving the previous certificate, and the browser will show an untrusted-certificate warning on the settings page. It disappears after the restart. Continue?
confirm.removeAll.description: This will completely remove dns-quorum-filter's local data: the trusted certificate, the TLS key, the log/cache encryption key, and the saved MaxMind credentials from Windows Credential Manager, as well as the whole app-data folder (log, cache, settings). The app will close, and Windows Settings will open - click "Uninstall" on dns-quorum-filter there. Continue?
confirm.pause.description: DNS will keep working, but filtering will be turned off: the quorum check and GeoIP won't apply, domains resolve directly through the baseline resolver. Your own allow/block lists keep working. Resume from this same menu item or by restarting the app. Continue?
confirm.quit.title: Quit
confirm.quit.description: The app will fully stop: DNS filtering, the background watchdog, and this icon. DNS will go unfiltered until you start the app again from the Start menu. Continue?
onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.description:
Two steps left before the browser starts filtering DNS:

1. Install the local certificate - without it the browser won't trust the settings page.
2. Point the browser's settings at the local filter - the instructions page opens right after step 1.

Install the certificate now?
